semantic_insights: The record consistently distinguishes 2022 project plans, September 2025 webinar observations and the undated website snapshot.
The website's 50,000 admissions and the webinar's earlier lower bound of over 45,000 admissions are not inherently contradictory.
Twenty collaborating academic centers and fourteen data-acquisition centers describe different organizational roles.
The record explicitly avoids equating patient counts with admission counts and avoids treating the GitHub project's MIT license as the dataset license.
Current enclave availability, local retention of clinical notes and incomplete imaging or EEG processing are qualified rather than presented as uniformly complete.
OMOP mapping, modality standards, tooling and SOP descriptions provide substantive interoperability evidence.
Documentation gaps do not establish that the underlying dataset lacks ethical oversight, privacy protections or quality controls; they limit what a reader can verify from this record.
